data.gender_notes: Irappa is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Irappa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Iru’ meaning ‘two’ and ‘appa’ meaning ‘father’. This name is a reference to Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as the father of the universe and the destroyer of evils. Irappa is believed to be a devotee or servant of Lord Shiva, making it a powerful and spiritual name for a baby boy in Hindu tradition.
